# teams_survivable_branch_appliance (Resource)

Manages the SurvivableBranchAppliance policy via New-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliance / Get-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliance / Set-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliance / Remove-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `fqdn` (String) Maps to the -Fqdn parameter.
- `site` (String) Maps to the -Site parameter.

### Read-Only
